title: Major Tech Giants Block Compromised eMudhra Certificates
excerpt: Mozilla, Google, and Apple have blocked eight compromised intermediate certificates from certificate authority eMudhra.
body_html:
Mozilla, Google, and Apple have blocked a set of compromised intermediate certificates issued by the certificate authority eMudhra. The action follows a discovery by researchers that these certificates relied on private keys that were weak enough to be recovered almost instantly.

Because of the vulnerability, attackers could have potentially used the weak keys to forge trusted certificates for legitimate websites. In response to the findings, eMudhra revoked the eight affected intermediate certificates to prevent potential misuse and secure the trust chain for users across major browsers and operating systems.
